name: better-edurec
description: Unofficial, read-only redesign of NUS EduRec as a Chrome extension.

scripts.check: node --check src/boot.js && node --check src/core.js && node --check src/routes.js && node --check src/parsers.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/themes.js && node --check src/keys.js && node --check src/timetable.js && node --check src/guide.js && node --check src/shell.js && node --check src/overview.js && node --check src/layout.js && node --check src/views.js && node --check src/enhancers.js && node --check src/main.js && node --check popup/popup.js && node --check scripts/serve.mjs && node --check scripts/release.mjs && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check dev/reload.js
scripts.pack: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.site: rm -rf dist/site && mkdir -p dist/site/test/harness dist/site/docs/store && cp site/index.html dist/site/ && cp -r src faq icons dist/site/ && cp test/harness/index.html dist/site/test/harness/ && cp docs/store/*.png dist/site/docs/store/
